cases.name: demo: kinetic energy, no formula line and no unit

question.text: A body of mass 2 kg moves at 3 m/s. Find its kinetic energy.

cases.scheme: 1. States the given values with symbols (2 marks). 2. Writes the formula E = 1/2 m v^2 before using it (2 marks). 3. Substitutes the values correctly (2 marks). 4. Calculates correctly: E = 9 (2 marks). 5. Gives the final answer with the unit, 9 J (2 marks).
